scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/server build && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/server test && bun run --cwd apps/web test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/server typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd apps/server lint && bun run --cwd apps/web lint
